board.withinColumn: index 0 is visual top, index 5 is visual bottom; Game1830ResultDisplay.onGetColToIdx reverses the slice before filling from the bottom

symbols.note: GamePropID only names Scatter=11. SymbolDesc uses label_wild for Scatter and multiplier copy, not a substituting Wild. Help never describes Wild substitution.

winModel.rule: At every spin, any combinations of 8 or more matching symbols appear anywhere on the reels will result in a winning combination. Client eliminates every cell whose symbolId equals win_arr[i].p.
evidence: Game1830BetDetails onTipsCallBack bet X level X odd

bet.chargedStakeFromDirtyQuarantineCheck: response.bet_gold = request.bet_gold * level * 20 (0.02*10*20=4); dirty fixture only, not a complete-round count

ordinaryLoss.definition: A complete paid Round whose legal terminal state has no Scatter Free Spins feature and no positive total_win. Client: checkScatterModel is false (frees.st==0) and last page win_arr is empty / total_win==0 / change_gold equals -response.bet_gold.
ordinaryLoss.httpShape: One POST /cp/single_game.Game/gameResult while isScatterIng is false; props may still be a single page.

ordinaryWin.definition: A complete paid Round with positive settlement (total_win>0 or last-page tw>0) that does not enter Scatter Free Spins (frees.st==0 after the paid gameResult, checkScatterModel false).
ordinaryWin.cascade: All props pages of that one gameResult belong to the same paid spin.

specialScatterFreeSpins.triggerPaid: 3 Scatter (id=11) anywhere awards 10 free spins; each extra Scatter +2. Frontend: type!=2 and scatterCount>=3; award 10+2*(count-3).
specialScatterFreeSpins.retriggerInFree: 2 Scatter anywhere during Free Spins awards 5 more. Frontend: type==2 and scatterCount>=2; award 5+2*(count-2). Help: Free spins can be retriggered.
specialScatterFreeSpins.clientFlag: isScatterIng set true after Game1830GetFreeTimesView; cleared when frees.st==0 on a later gameResult

freesFieldsConsumed.tt: total free spins of this feature; extra popup uses tt-OldScatterNum; feature summary when tt>0 and st==0
freesFieldsConsumed.twa: feature accumulated win shown on FreeSpinTotalWinView as twa+lwa
freesFieldsConsumed.lwa: added to twa for feature total display

specialScatterFreeSpins.roundIncludes: The paid trigger gameResult plus every subsequent gameResult until frees.st==0 and Game1830FreeSpinTotalWinView, then GAME_ENDED
specialScatterFreeSpins.multiplierHelp: During free spins multiplier symbols range x5 to x50; during main game x2 to x5. All multipliers on the reels are summed and multiply that spin total win.

buy.reason: Game1830 has no buy API, no buy button, no buy form, and Help never describes a purchase. Promo FreeBetTimes/act_id is an activity free-bet, not a game mode.

roundBoundary.paidStart: Player is in INIT or GAME_ENDED, isScatterIng is false, RequestBet calls RequestGameBet (POST gameResult) after RecBetClick resets PageIndex to 0
roundBoundary.spinTerminal: ResultDisplay.checkGameEnd true (last props page) then setGameEnd -> GAME_ENDED, or BigWin then OnPlayBigWinEndEvent
roundBoundary.featureContinue: If checkScatterModel (frees.st>0) after a paid spin, GetFreeTimesView then isScatterIng=true; further BetClick still POST gameResult without charging (isScatterIng skips gold deduct and bet limit)
roundBoundary.featureTerminal: isScatterIng && frees.st==0 clears the flag; if frees.tt>0 && frees.st==0 show FreeSpinTotalWinView then DISPLAYEND / GAME_ENDED
roundBoundary.completeRound: From the paid gameResult inclusive through the last legal GAME_ENDED of that paid start, including all cascade pages inside each gameResult and all free gameResult calls if triggered

detail.groups: data.results[] — index 0 labelled Normal Spin, later groups Free Spin

history.lightweightPolicy: After classification, capture list+detail once per confirmed outcome. Do not attach full history to every spin. Do not use history to fill 200/200/30.

unimplementedUntilCleanSamples: symbol generation weights for start page vs cascade fill vs free page
